description: Transcription quality improvements for Parakeet TDT 0.6B / Whisper ASR pipeline. Each item addresses a specific audio pipeline issue that degrades transcription accuracy or recording quality.

improvements.name: Raise Normalization Target to -16 LUFS
improvements.description: EBU R128 target of -23 LUFS (broadcast standard) is too quiet for meeting recordings. Podcast/voice standard is -16 LUFS. This reduces effective SNR going into the ASR model and makes saved recordings hard to hear.
improvements.expected_impact: Louder recordings, better SNR for ASR (~1-3% WER improvement), directly fixes 'quiet audio' complaint
changes: Change TARGET_LUFS from -23.0 to -16.0 in LoudnessNormalizer::normalize_loudness()

improvements.name: Improve VAD Resampling Quality
improvements.description: VAD module resamples 48kHz -> 16kHz using basic low-pass + linear interpolation instead of the high-quality Rubato sinc resampler used elsewhere. This introduces aliasing artifacts in the audio sent to the transcription engine.
improvements.expected_impact: Cleaner 16kHz audio for ASR, reduced aliasing artifacts, ~1-2% WER improvement
changes: Replaced VAD's internal resample_to_16k with persistent Rubato SincFixedIn resampler
512-tap sinc filter, Cubic interpolation, BlackmanHarris2 window, f_cutoff=0.95
Persistent resampler with input buffering (512-sample chunks) to preserve state across calls
Basic linear interpolation kept as fallback if Rubato init fails

improvements.name: Buffer Longer Segments Before Transcription
improvements.description: Current VAD sends speech segments as soon as endpoints are detected (often 1-3 seconds). Parakeet TDT works best with longer context (up to 24 minutes). Short segments lose context at boundaries, hurting accuracy.
improvements.expected_impact: Better word accuracy at segment boundaries, ~2-5% WER improvement for short utterances
improvements.revert_reason: Made transcription quality worse in practice — accumulating segments delayed output and degraded results
changes: REVERTED: All accumulation buffer code removed, VAD segments sent directly to transcription engine
